Name: Parenthood Config
Author: Emyyy
Description:
Take control of your Stardew Valley family life with this simple yet powerful configuration mod. Whether you're roleplaying a slow-burn romance or building a bustling household, this mod lets you fine-tune two key mechanics:
🔧 Features[list]
[*][b]Baby Question Chance[/b]: Adjust how often your spouse asks about having a baby. Set it to 0 for no questions, or crank it up for a fast-growing family.
[*][b]Maximum Number of Children[/b]: Change the default cap of 2 children to any number you like. Want a cozy one-child household or a full house of 5? It’s up to you.
[/list]🛠️ Configuration
Edit the file to set your preferred values:
json
[code]config.json

{
﻿"BabyQuestionChance": 0.5,
﻿"MaxChildren": 3
}[/code][list]
[*]BabyQuestionChance: A decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.5 = 50% chance).
[*]MaxChildren: Any integer ≥ 0.
[/list]✅ Compatibility[list]
[*]Requires [b]SMAPI[/b]
[*]Uses [b]Content Patcher[/b] for seamless integration
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]Works well alongside other family or spouse mods, provided they don’t override the same logic
[/list]📦 Example Use Cases[list]
[*]Roleplay a child-free couple by setting MaxChildren to 0
[*]Increase realism by lowering BabyQuestionChance to 0.1
[*]Create a large family farm with MaxChildren set to 5+
[/list]📜 Changelog[b]v1.0.0
[/b]
[list]
[*]Initial release
[*]Configurable baby question chance
[*]Configurable max children limit
[/list]
